title: A Little Disappointed
text: A Little Disappointed. You get a Friends branded Central Perk travel mug which stays capped fairly well though a sharp knock can pop the cap lose. You also get a single packet of cappuccino latte mix. Just enough to make six ounces of coffee. That's it. A travel mug with a logo from a popular TV show and a single small cup of coffee. Granted it was tasty coffee but they could have included a couple packets of mix and maybe something else related to the show; keyring, lanyard, something to make this worth the price. The mug will get reused, the packaging went to a landfill and the 6 ounces of coffee were barely enough to give us both a taste. Somewhat disappointed in this.

product_metadata.title: Thoughtfully Gifts, Friends Travel Mug and Coffee Gift Set, Includes Friends Central Perk Travel Coffee Cup with Lid and Cappuccino Latte Mix
